Hold out until we can figure out a fix!|[[Commander (Narrator)|Commander]] dialogue on Wave 1 ([[Outpost 32 (Frost Invasion)|Outpost 32]])}} }} __TOC__ ==Description== The '''Snowy''' was an enemy that appeared exclusively in [[Outpost 32 (Frost Invasion)|Outpost 32]], and was the first enemy to spawn, as part of the [[Frost Invasion Event]]. Currently, it can be spawned again in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode, though it uses the [[Operation I.C.E Event]] [[Snowy]] statistics. It had average speed, but low health. Upon its death, the [[Frost Mystery (Frost Invasion)|Frost Mystery]] had a chance to spawn the '''Snowy'''. ==Appearance== The '''Snowy''' has light blue head and arms, along with a light grey torso and legs which are made presumably made out of powdered snow. It has no facial features. ==Event Strategy== As this enemy only appears through [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode, no strategy section is made for its current version. Instead, a strategy section for the one that appeared without [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode in [[Outpost 32 (Frost Invasion)|Outpost 32]] is listed instead. *'''Snowies''' come in hordes at the start of the game and should be dealt with accordingly, generally with towers that can damage multiple enemies at once. **The [[Pyromancer]] is the best way to combat the '''Snowy'''. It is a multi-hit tower, deals double fire damage to the '''Snowy''' (as with all enemies in the [[Frost Invasion Event]]) and can be placed down at the start of the game. ***There should be at least two Level 2 [[Pyromancer]]s placed down at the start of the map to deal with the first few hordes of '''Snowies'''. **Splash damage towers like the [[Mortar]] can do fairly well against the '''Snowy'''. ***The [[Swarmer]]'s ''Beehive Grenade'' ability is excellent at dealing with '''Snowies''', though it is too expensive to upgrade the [[Swarmer]] early on in the game. **Later on in the game, '''Snowies''' are not an issue and can be dealt with using late game towers. *As your base health in [[Outpost 32 (Frost Invasion)|Outpost 32]] is set to 200, it is not a major issue if multiple '''Snowies''' get to the exit at the start of the match. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Animations}} SnowyWalk.gif|Current Walk Animation (8 May 2021 – Present). {{GalleryHeader|Corpse Variants}} CorpseLegacySnowy.png|Second [[Corpse (Enemy)|Corpse]] variant, current version (12 March 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Development Videos}} SledgerDev.gif|Unused version of the '''Snowy''' in a development video. {{GalleryHeader|Miscellaneous}} FrostInvasionSnowyIconIG.png|'''Snowy''' on its [[Index]] icon. }} ==Trivia== *The '''Snowy''' originally had a slightly different design before being added, where it had a shocked face, similar to one used by other event enemies, like the [[Undead (Trick or Threat Town)|Undead]] or [[Reanimated]]. ==Update History== *'''8 May 2021''' - [[Overhaul v1.0]] **'''Snowy''' added. *'''4 December 2021''' - [[v1.0.0]] **'''Snowy''' removed. *'''20 December 2024''' - [[v1.47.0]] **'''Snowy''' can now be summoned in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode, only when the player has the [[Snowy]]'s [[Logbooks|Logbook]] from the [[Operation I.C.E Event]]. *'''12 February 2025''' -
